hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(node_modules|package-lock\.json|\.env)' && echo 'BLOCKED: Do not edit this file' && exit 1 || exit 0
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '\.(astro|ts|mjs|css|md)"'; then npm run build 2>&1 | tail -5; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE 'src/content/posts/[^"]+\.mdx?'); if [ -n "$FILE" ]; then WORDS=$(wc -w < "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '); if [ "$WORDS" -gt 200 ]; then echo 'New blog post with content detected. Consider running /interlink to add internal cross-links.'; fi; fi
